requirements.title: PSPF on a page 2026
requirements.text: The PSPF on a page provides an overview of the Protective Security Policy Framework.

directions.title: Direction 002-2026 on Strengthening Commonwealth Cyber Posture Against AI-Enabled Risks
directions.text: PSPF Direction 002-2026 requires Australian Government entities to reduce cyber security risks arising from vulnerable legacy technology systems and to strengthen cyber posture across Australian Government systems.

directions.title: Direction 001-2026 on Mitigate Vulnerabilities in Cisco SD-WAN Systems
directions.text: PSPF Direction 001-2026 requires Australian Government entities to inventory Cisco Software-Defined Wide-Area Networking (SD-WAN) systems, apply updates, assess and report potential compromise and prevent the installation of unpatched versions from all Australian Government systems and devices.
